title: Registry entry
description: One sourced factor in the Evidence Registry. Produced by Member A, read by B (estimator) and C (citation badges).

value.description: The single figure the source states; null when the source only gives a range.

range.description: Always present. low == high when the source states a single figure.

counts.description: direct = on-site data-center cooling water; indirect = water behind the electricity. not_applicable for non-water factors such as energy.

source_date.description: Publication date at the precision the source gives (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

evidence.description: What the source says, and what it does and does not count.

superseded_by.description: Set when status is stale: the newer source that disagrees with this entry.

version_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the entry, excluding version_hash and freshness_score.
